facts.fact: The Office National de la Météorologie and UNDP run an AI-based agrometeorological early warning system whose services already benefit 20 women's cooperatives in Rosso, AMI reports; UNDP's sustainable development unit head says it supports yield estimates, climate risk forecasting and early crop disease diagnosis.
